about: Public keys only. A three-floor descent (stage-exit-scenarios.py `descent`): Monstro on Basement I, Larry Jr. on Basement II, Mega Fatty on Caves I, then the shared exit into Caves II. route and the Basement I and II legs are EV9BP18Q-descent's. originalFight: the original's own keys from boss-room-arrival to the bottom-left corner of Caves I's boss room. Through Basement II's corner they are EV9BP18Q-descent's fight; then come that fixture's shared Basement II exit and stage transition, and the Caves I route 5 -> 6 -> 7 -> 9 -> 10 -> 11 -> 12 -> 13 -> 0 with every room fought clear, the Mega Fatty kill and the corner hold (S+A 60 frames, released, one frame), then one blast of the player's own bomb. From the corner it walks up (W 20), up-right (W+D 20) and right (D 70) to about (444, 277) (row 4, column 10), drops its bomb (E), steps down (S 10) and waits: the blast takes 2 of its 3 red half-hearts and throws it into the bottom wall. It walks up (W 30), left (A 110) and back into the corner (S+A 60, released, one frame). The bomb cell keeps clear of everything the blast could touch: 131 units from the nearest grid object (cell 82's destroyed rock), 146 from the open trapdoor, 150 from the pedestal and 185 from the hearts, against the blast's 75-unit radius; the walks pass at least 67 units from the pedestal and 77 from the trapdoor. A fresh original keeps every grid cell, both hearts and the pedestal unchanged through it. The Caves I keys were found once by a research controller, room by room: several seeded variants per room from the same replayed prefix, keeping the one that ended with the most health. A fresh original replays them to the same state. The route is forced (one door chain), and the floor's layout does not depend on the health or coins Basement II leaves. descent: each floor's boss room chain, boss and the original's health after its fight. The Caves I floor gives the port's closed-loop leg its own fight budget and fightFlags (boss-route-record.mjs --dodge --salt 4), which shape only the port's own segment; the original's keys stay this fixed recording. Caves II's generation reads the departing Player's health and coins: full red health (the Challenge and Sacrifice rooms), a half heart without soul hearts (the bedrooms) and five or more coins (an Arcade). The port's closed-loop leg ends Caves I on a half heart (1 of 6 red, 0 coins), so the original's keys end with that bomb, as --hurt blasts a port that ends full: both games leave Caves I with 1 of 6 red, neither full nor holding five coins (the original has 1). stage-exit-state-pair.mjs compares those predicates at the re-anchor; raw health, coins and bombs are diagnostics. The original spends its one bomb and the port keeps its own; neither generation nor the shared tail reads the bomb count. window: the frames from boss-room-arrival to exit-start, set by the original's 47,740-frame segment. originalSolid: none after the fight. originalPickups: the two hearts the original's fight leaves on the floor; the shared walk keeps off them. No curse on stages 1-4 for this seed.
